'''2000 Missouri State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Missouri on 22 April 2000. [[Matt Wehner]] won it. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d615">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-28-missouri-state-championship-part-2d615/ missouri-state-championship-part-2], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 28 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-28-missouri-state-championship-part-2d615/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 April 2000
* '''Site:''' Missouri
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 32
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Wehner]]
